ModMetaData.name: Visual Progression: Medieval Overhaul Meals
ModMetaData.author: Groovy
ModMetaData.description: Simple, fine and lavish meals, packaged survival meals and nutrient paste made before your colony reaches the industrial age use Medieval Overhaul's meal art. Meals made after use the normal art. Old meals keep their look until they're eaten, so the change happens slowly. This mod contains no art. It uses Medieval Overhaul's own images.
